## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] Format check passes
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh exists and is executable
- [ ] Fixture passes: all 6 DD scenarios (cycle-declaration, forced-failing, oscillation, HALT-vs-REPLAN, mid-loop-success, PROTOCOL_ERROR)
- [ ] grep -q 'Current cycle: N of MAX_CYCLES' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md
- [ ] grep -q 'See:.*protocol' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md
- [ ] grep -q 'oscillation-check' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md (cycle >= 2 gate)
- [ ] grep -qE 'REPLAN_ESCALATE:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md
- [ ] Run: bash tests/scripts/test-loop-touchpoint-preplanning-phase-e.sh → PASS
